features.name: Payment Mode
features.description: New Payment Mode component and flow — method cards sourced from feature data, amount entry, a denomination sub-modal, and Bill/Paid/Balance totals; Confirm Payment submits the transaction.

features.name: Overflow (⋮) Menu
features.description: New kebab-menu component that groups actions (Import, Email, Print, Hold, Recall) behind one trigger; items persist on Save and render in the action toolbar.

features.name: Discount Coupon
features.description: Discount Coupon component — shoppers enter a code that is validated against configured coupons and applies a discount (builder + runtime); the computed discount can be written to a referenceable field.

features.name: DISTINCT formula aggregates
features.description: New DISTINCT aggregate family — DISTINCT_COUNT / SUM / AVG / MIN / MAX_OF_RECORDS plus a SQL-style DISTINCT({field}) modifier — for unique-value calculations (e.g. unique outlets, active users).
features.impact: Distinct-count metrics the engine previously couldn't express.

features.name: Button – link & open-modal
features.description: Buttons support a text "link" variant and an "open-modal" action that opens any modal on the page.

features.name: Table cell display mode
features.description: Table columns can render as a read-only label that becomes editable on click, with per-column Cell Display, output decimals, and footer decimals.

features.name: Adjustable column width in Preview
features.description: Column widths are respected and columns can be marked "adjustable" for Excel-style drag-resizing in Preview.
features.impact: Tune table columns directly in preview.

features.name: Formula field "Show As: Label"
features.description: Formula fields can render as a label row (label-left / value-right) with optional inline editing and summary-row styling (sign prefixes, coloured/emphasised values).

features.name: Configurable modal styling & footer
features.description: Per-modal flat/Figma style overrides, a configurable set of footer action buttons, and custom Submit/Cancel labels.

features.name: Builder Preview guard
features.description: Previewing an unpublished form shows a "Back to Builder" button and is view-only — Submit and Save-as-Draft are blocked.

enhancements.description: DISTINCT aggregates now run as a MongoDB group query — a ~12k-row distinct count drops from ~16.8s to ~0.55s.
DISTINCT aggregates now appear in autocomplete/help; an Expression Builder render loop was fixed.
Projection-formula rows are evaluated with bounded parallelism, fetching only the reference fields a response needs.
Formula columns support Sum / Average / Min / Max footer totals, not just Count.
Pivot headers show readable labels instead of raw field keys, with an opt-in modern (Figma) style.
Button icons persist on Save/Publish; the icon picker uses the tenant brand colour with proper alignment.
Column width is now single-source — a width set to 20% no longer reverts to 35%.
Line items (including quantities) can be copied from another feature via a header lookup.
Desktop preview scrolls only the form body; tall columns scroll internally (no global page scrollbar); tighter header/padding; the summary/right column stays fully visible.
Sits below the fixed app header, clips to its rounded corners, shows the real data-field count, and themes the Device Visibility card to brand.
Clears the fixed app header and scrolls tall content internally.
Shows the true recursive component count and matches the Save modal's size and position.
Feature-backed dropdowns open in the correct position without flicker, show a single brand focus ring, and no longer flash on selection.
Display-only components (labels/headings/dividers) no longer appear as empty columns and are excluded from the submitted payload.
The payment value renders as method chips with Paid/Balance (not raw JSON); Confirm Payment shows a spinner and disables during submit.
Sections reflow when a nested accordion collapses; the accordion header title aligns with its chevron.
The "Save as Draft" button label is editable and persists.
Advanced Layout toggles can be deselected by clicking the active option.
Compact, aligned default layout with themed line-icons that follow the text colour.
Inactive workspaces show a neutral gray icon chip; only the active one keeps the brand tint.

knownIssues: Because some menu structures have changed, certain features may return a 403 status code. To resolve this, edit the role, select the platform feature, and save the role again.
Use the conventional feature-wise approach wherever workflow scheduling is required.
Formula Builder UI – Field Insertion Through Typing
This works in current fields. For external feature fields, it won't work, as there could be fields with same names from multiple features.
Formula Builder – AI-Based Formula Writing/Editing Not Implemented
Organization Details → Basic Info: Website URL accepts invalid URL formats without validation.
Expected: Validate the URL format and show an error message for invalid values, such as www.example or example@123.www.example
Builder Tool Not Available on Mobile Web
The builder tool is not supported on mobile web. This is implemented as expected — builder functionality is restricted to desktop browsers by design. It should be available on Tab though.
Mobile – Formula Field Not Working in Tables & Charts
Formula fields are not evaluated correctly when used inside Tables and Charts on mobile. This is under review.
AI Components — the AI Text Generator, OCR Extraction (Field Extraction), and Doc Summarizer currently do not work, because the LLM Gateway API is blocking the domains (CORS).
Use OCR Extraction (General Extraction), which works as expected.
configChanges: Re-seed `componentProperties` in the target environment so the new component styling/config keys (table column display mode & number format, and label styling authored under `advanced.*`) persist on Save.
Without the re-seed, these styling/config keys are stripped on save.
